lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p24 - Remember the story.

details: Remember the story activates memory and recaps the narrative context. Students recall the events from the first half of the story to prepare for the conclusion.
Look for students identifying the characters from the previous lesson and recalling that they were looking for the library.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p24 - Talk about the value.

details: Talk about the value fosters social-emotional learning. Students identify the helping behaviours in the pictures (carrying boxes, painting) to understand the concept of "Help others."
Look for students pointing to the characters who are helping and simple verbal acknowledgement (e.g., "He is helping," "Painting").

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p61 - 2. Point and say.

details: Point and say provides controlled practice of the story language. Students point to the images and say the target sentences to reinforce the "We [action] in the [room]" structure.
Look for clear pronunciation of the sentence "We read in the library" or "We play in the playground" while pointing to the correct matched pair.
